title: FBI Photo B5
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO containing a redacted sensor still image of an unidentified object, with an incorrect system timestamp.

incidents.summary: A grainy, grayscale sensor still showing a crosshair reticle and an indistinct smudge, submitted by the FBI to AARO.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: A faint, indistinct, darker smudge or object is visible just below and slightly left of the crosshair's center.
